q: Do we have to sign a long contract?
a: No. Plans run month to month after a short onboarding period. We would rather keep you by doing good work.

q: Can you work with the IT person we already have?
a: Yes. Many clients keep an internal IT lead. We take the day-to-day tickets and the after-hours watch so they can focus on projects.
During business hours a technician picks up the phone directly. Our average first response on tickets is 12 minutes.

q: What happens during the free check-up?
a: We scan your network, devices and Microsoft 365 or Google accounts, then walk you through what we found in a 30-minute call. You keep the report either way.

q: Do you work with Google Workspace?
a: Yes. We run Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace every day, and can move you from one to the other. Not sure which fits? We lay out the trade-offs plainly.
Yes. Our help desk takes calls and tickets in English and French.
